about_short_description.short_description: Craftwork is a full-service home painting company that uses software to dramatically improve the homeowner and operator experiences.

product.name: Interior Painting
product.description: Painting service for the interior walls and surfaces of residential homes, including preparation and color selection.

product.name: Exterior Painting
product.description: Painting service for the exterior surfaces of residential buildings to protect and enhance curb appeal.

product.name: Cabinetry Refinishing
product.description: Refinishing and painting of kitchen or bathroom cabinets to update their appearance without full replacement.

product.name: Community Painting Services
product.description: Coordinated painting projects for residential communities, including scheduling, homeowner communication, and multi-property painting.

product.name: Virtual Estimation and Project Planning
product.description: Remote estimation and project planning service using photos and videos to provide detailed painting quotes and schedules.
